Definition: from G2596 and G3034; to stone down, i.e. to death:--stone.
BiblicalUsage: The chief priests feared the people would stone them, because all were persuaded that John was a prophet.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the fear of the crowd kept them from saying what they really thought, and that is the fear of man at work.
